personality_one_liner: A clean, calm, and grounded utility focusing on precise tracking without the clinical or generic AI feel, using botanical ceramic tones.

spacing.rule: Generous padding. Cards never flush to edge (minimum md margin). Use Safe Area context.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it

screens.name: Timer
screens.purpose: Manual tracking with large live HH:MM:SS countdown and cost/liter metrics.

states.empty: Initial zero-state with a prominent Start button.
states.error: Failed to save session with Retry.

screens.layout: Large SpaceGrotesk timer text placed centrally. Secondary metrics (Liters, Cost) grouped in subtle surfaceTertiary pills below the timer. Prominent Start/Pause/Stop CTA at the bottom thumb zone. Background can have a soft brandTertiary gradient or subtle circular layout to emphasize focus. Settings cog at the top right.

screens.name: Smart Meter
screens.purpose: Auto-detects shower sounds via mic to start/stop the timer automatically.

states.error: Microphone permission denied layout with 'Open Settings' CTA.

screens.layout: Central live scrolling audio waveform visualization (using actual metering data). Status text indicating 'Listening...' or 'Shower Detected'. Clean, unobstructed UI to reduce cognitive load. Stop Auto-detect button pinned at bottom.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Log of past sessions grouped by date.

states.empty: Grayscale water drop image + 'No showers recorded yet'.

screens.layout: Scrollable list of cards (surfaceSecondary) with md spacing. Each row uses Phosphor filled icons for visuals, showing Date/Time (title) and Duration/Liters (trailing). Swipe-to-delete pattern on rows.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Visual breakdown of shower time, water used, and costs.
screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (7 / 14 / 30 / 90 days). Bar charts for daily usage. 2-column grid of summary stat cards (Total Time, Total Water, Total Cost) using surfaceSecondary cards.

screens.name: Settings (Sheet)
screens.purpose: Configure water flow rate and cost factor.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet or modal. Single-column form with labels above inputs. Large 'Save' button fixed at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

history_empty_state.alt: Grayscale macro shot of a clean water droplet creating ripples

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the botanical/ceramic palette (Seafoam/Sage green). ABSOLUTELY NO BLUES (no navy, sky, royal, etc.) anywhere in the app, as per the strict negative prompts for generic AI visuals.
Use SpaceGrotesk (Medium, max weight 500) for numeric timer displays and PlusJakartaSans for body UI text. Ensure large numbers are centered and highly legible.
Implement fully local SQLite or AsyncStorage database for offline capabilities.

The Smart Meter waveform should read live metering data from expo-audio (or equivalent stable library) and display it as a scrolling visual, not a static/looping animation. Be honest with the mic data.
Apply Glassmorphism (expo-blur or expo-glass-effect) to the bottom tab bar and any sticky headers (like the Analytics segment control), falling back to solid surfaceSecondary on low-end Android.
For Analytics charts, avoid clutter. Use subtle bar graphs matching the brandPrimary color, keeping labels minimalistic.
If text is layered over the analytics_hero_bg or history_empty_state images, always use the gradient scrim pattern (transparent -> 70% surfaceInverse) behind the text to ensure WCAG AAA readability.
